description: Spec defines sender-controlled message expiry. senderExpiresAt (UTCDate, optional, immutable): hard-deletion deadline, server MUST permanently delete the message (no tombstone) at or before this time. burnOnRead (Boolean, optional, immutable): server deletes after all recipients have read. Both are set at send time, immutable after. Needs: store support, background reaper task, Peer/deliver acceptance, interaction with messageExpirySeconds on Chat. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines 618-619, 631-655.
title: Implement Message expiry (senderExpiresAt, burnOnRead)
